highlights_headline: Upcoming changes modernize Uno integration and correct native interop, rendering, and stream-lifetime behavior.
highlights_body: This post-preview work raises Apple deployment requirements and updates Windows integration. It also paces automatic Android texture rendering to the display clock and fixes Linux HarfBuzz symbol conflicts.

breaking.title: Move Uno integrations to Uno Platform 7
breaking.body: Non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, renders through a CPU fallback, reports null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering and the .NET SDK WASM pipeline. Windows package facades retain the WinAppSDK control.

breaking.title: Respect the raised Apple deployment minimums
breaking.body: Native libraries now require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 requirements remain higher and unchanged. Raise application deployment targets as needed and honor the highest requirement in the application stack.

breaking.title: Keep SKData.CreateCopy lengths within the source array
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

breaking.title: Pass one encoded unit to character-code conversion
breaking.body: StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates the encoded byte width rather than UTF-16 string length. Pass one code unit for the selected encoding; use Utf32 for supplementary characters. Invalid multi-unit input is rejected with ArgumentException. GetString(byte[], SKTextEncoding) now reports ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null data.

breaking.title: Use rebuilt Graphite-enabled WebGPU archives
breaking.body: emdawnwebgpu C++ support now ships inside libSkiaSharp.a instead of compiling on the application's final link line. Use matching rebuilt Graphite-enabled archives; pre-change archives and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy the new link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained.

bullets.lead: Android continuous frames follow display refresh
bullets.detail: Automatic GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows Choreographer pulses instead of buffer-swap throughput. Painting remains on the GL worker; explicit render requests and synchronous lifecycle progress remain independent of display callbacks.

bullets.lead: Linux HarfBuzz stays within its bundled implementation
bullets.detail: Binds internal HarfBuzz function calls locally to prevent conflicts when GTK or another library loads a different HarfBuzz globally. Managed signatures and exported entry points are unchanged.

bullets.lead: Callbacks use the correct native boolean widths
bullets.detail: Corrects Skia stream, write-stream, and Graphite image-provider callbacks, including Mono ARM64 interpreter behavior, and HarfBuzz font/Unicode callbacks. Public delegates still use bool. False glyph-name callbacks return without copying the name span.

bullets.lead: WASM WebGPU support no longer compiles C++ in application links
bullets.detail: Moves WebGPU port compilation out of the application's final link, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources. JavaScript glue remains a linker input rather than deployed application content.
Ganesh disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that advertise GL_RGBA, a configuration accepted by desktop GL but invalid in GLES. Readback is unchanged.

bullets.lead: SkSL rejects invalid shader programs earlier
bullets.detail: Rejects overflowing raster-pipeline slot counts and reserved invalid runtime-effect types, including struct member types, before later compilation stages.

bullets.lead: Disposed front-buffered streams release borrowed references
bullets.detail: Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal.

bullets.lead: Image pixel copies avoid intermediate SKData
bullets.detail: Valid managed image pixel copies bypass an intermediate SKData allocation. Invalid inputs retain the original path and native validation behavior.

bullets.lead: Fewer HarfBuzz encoding and feature-string allocations
bullets.detail: UTF-32 string encoding uses pooled storage, and feature-string conversion avoids a native allocation while preserving decoding semantics, including legacy target frameworks and arbitrary raw tag values.

Updates ANGLE to chromium/8118 and the library dependency baseline to Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003, Windows SDK BuildTools 10.0.22621.756, and WebView2 1.0.3179.45. Native source builds move to VS 2026/MSVC v145; the WinUI declared runtime minimum remains Windows 10 build 17763.
